accommodation.notes_base: Gaode Maps rating 4.8 stars. '隐序时空.界' (Hidden Sequence of Time · Boundary) — a poetic, deeply literary boutique hotel that is one of the most talked-about 网红酒店 in Kunming on 小红书. The name alone resonates powerfully with INFJ aesthetic: 隐 (hidden/understated), 序 (order/narrative), 时空 (time-space), 界 (boundary/realm). Located on Wuyi Road near the historic Kunming Old Street district, only 5 minutes walk from the iconic 翠湖 (Green Lake) — perfect for evening lakeside strolls. Boutique designer rooms with carefully curated 文艺温馨 atmosphere, ideal for one special night in Kunming. Metro access right at doorstep. Est. 700-900 CNY/night. Highly recommended to book Deluxe or Lake-View room.
accommodation.notes_local: 高德地图评分4.8星。「隐序时空·界」酒店是昆明小红书最热门的网红精品酒店之一，以诗意文学的品牌名和设计感十足的室内空间闻名。位于五一路昆明老街区域，步行5分钟即达昆明地标翠湖公园，适合傍晚环湖漫步。文艺温馨的精品客房设计，极具INFJ气质的浪漫氛围，是昆明中转一晚的最佳选择。地铁华山西路B口步行170米。预估700-900元/晚，推荐预订大床房或湖景房。

accommodation.notes_base: Gaode Maps rating: 4.9 stars. THE dream pastoral luxury resort in Lijiang — the Banyan Tree (悦榕庄) is an internationally acclaimed 5-star resort set in an expansive estate near Shuhe Ancient Town. Far from the busy old town crowds, the resort sits amidst countryside gardens, with rice paddy field views and distant Jade Dragon Snow Mountain panoramas. Multiple pools, a full Banyan Tree Spa, two on-site restaurants, and meandering garden paths make this a perfect 可以待一天 (spend-the-whole-day) sanctuary. The resort's Naxi-influenced architecture with private villa-style rooms, courtyards, and cozy reading corners is ideal for an INFJ couple. Arrive by high-speed rail from Kunming (approx 3h). Est. 1500-2200 CNY/night. Total 3 nights est. 5400-6600 CNY.
accommodation.notes_local: 高德地图评分4.9星。丽江最梦幻的高端田园度假胜地——悦榕庄是国际知名五星度假村，隐于束河古镇郊野，远离古城喧嚣。大片园林花园、稻田景观、玉龙雪山远景尽收眼底。室外泳池、悦榕庄Spa、两家酒店餐厅、迂回花园步道，是真正可以待一天的世外桃源。纳西风格别墅式客房、私家庭院、温馨阅读角，专为INFJ情侣打造。从昆明乘高铁约3小时抵达。预估1500-2200元/晚，3晚合计约5400-6600元。
